core_shots.anchor_text: Martos’s memory — age twenty, conventional service. Rain has driven families toward a school hall used for evacuation. He has been enlisted long enough to know that good intentions do not dry blankets or tell a waiting family where its missing transport went.

core_shots.anchor_text: Martos’s memory — later deployment, age twenty-four, before desertion. The order calls the removal a protective cordon. A woman named Ilen asks to take a chair to her mother, who cannot stand in the waiting line. Martos moves it back behind the boundary. He tells her supplies will be provided at the next stop.

core_shots.purpose: Limited escape supporting wounded Sera; no universal rescue.
core_shots.anchor_text: Martos supports wounded Sera toward the exit while the reachable group gathers beyond the open holding-room door. Behind the partition, somebody calls again. He cannot get to them before this route closes. Tomas was alive when he last saw him; he has no answer to the question Sera asks now. He keeps moving with the people he can reach.

core_shots.purpose: Recruitment in executive room with concealed Crow.
core_shots.anchor_text: A Syndicate intermediary brings a bounded offer and transport for an authorised headquarters appointment. At the executive desk the Crow remains concealed. He has a dossier from that channel: known service, the refusal, capabilities and the people whose support Martos is trying to maintain. He does not know every private conversation at the refuge.

core_shots.purpose: Holding departure line before resolution, receipt or custody.
core_shots.anchor_text: At the departure line, Voss appears beyond the route to the receiving area. Martos can see him clearly. The protected door is closer and less satisfying to watch. He checks it first.
